summary.text: Michael Gist is a no-party-affiliation candidate for Florida's 6th Congressional District. He describes himself as a Marine Corps veteran, former public-school teacher, and lifelong Volusia County resident running on a proposal he calls 'Freedom Accounts.' Ballotpedia lists him as having withdrawn while remaining on the ballot.

paragraphs.text: Describes his family as lifelong residents of Volusia County for over 100 years; says his grandmother returned to Ormond Beach after working in New York in 1939.

Earned a high school diploma from Seabreeze High School, a graduate degree from National University (2002), a military citation from the Naval War College (2005), and a graduate degree from the University of Florida (2018), according to Ballotpedia.
Says he served 14 years in the U.S. Marine Corps and later taught in Volusia County public schools.

Is running as a self-described conservative Independent; his signature proposal, Freedom Accounts, would redirect government spending into personal investment accounts, according to his survey. Ballotpedia lists him as having withdrawn but still on the ballot.
